svg.title: publiccode.yml - Core tools and how they interact
svg.desc: A card-based overview of the catalog architecture. Multiple code repositories feed the crawler, which uses libpubliccode in process and gets publishers from the API, then creates or updates software and logs. Multiple authorized clients include metrics tools, security scanners, quality checks and badges. Catalog reads are public; writes require a token. PostgreSQL overlaps the API card. Frontends read catalog data; publiccode-issueopener reports errors in publiccode.yml on GitHub. The API sends webhook notifications. Code examples show the corresponding API endpoints.
